flagged.evidence: Step 2.1 makes the available next-coordinate set depend on the already chosen prefix, then step 3.1 says: “By [F3], make these countably many compatible selections.” But [F3] cites def-countable-choice, whose definition supplies choices from a pre-specified countable family only. Its Remark explicitly distinguishes this from “choose x_0, then choose x_1 depending on x_0,” which requires dependent choice. Thus countable choice does not license the recursive compatible selection used to obtain a point in every C_n.

The title calls the result a “finitely additive cylinder premeasure,” but def-premeasure-on-an-algebra defines a premeasure as countably additive for qualifying disjoint sequences. The Statement and proof establish only that the formula is well-defined and finitely additive; countable additivity is neither assumed nor proved here. Thus the title asserts more than this item establishes.
